data.body: Completion evidence (all external facts verified 2026-08-02 ~18:15 PT via Gerrit REST /a/changes/<n>/detail and gh CLI): AC0: change 1238 MERGED with LLM-Review +1 (rebar-review-bot) and Verified +1 (rebar-ci-bot) — its CI pip-audit step passed on the patchset containing the click 8.4.2 lock (the run cannot go green otherwise; pre-fix runs, e.g. change 1243 ps1 run 30772560147, failed exactly that job).
